objective: Test whether a context-conditioned EDM over leakage-safe AR innovation sequences avoids CW11.1's catastrophic held-out distribution failure and improves at least one sequential morphology metric on each of two dataset-selected caves.

dataset.split_unit: entire named cave system and acquisition campaign

representation.state_equation: x_t = mean + rho * (x_(t-1) - mean) + innovation_t; token zero innovation is x_0 - mean
representation.fit_scope: mean, covariance, diagonal rho, innovation mean, innovation scale, and context normalization use the eleven training caves inside each fold only
representation.training_target: source-balanced standardized innovation sequence, not absolute morphology descriptor sequence
representation.clip_basis: training-only fold audit absolute p99 range 3.1867 to 3.3235
representation.masking: variable-length contiguous right-padded mask; padding remains exactly zero

registered_arms.coherent_ar: Source-balanced Gaussian AR innovations fitted on training caves; retained non-neural baseline.
registered_arms.empirical_innovation: Training-source-balanced independent resampling of measured standardized innovation tokens.
registered_arms.conditional_residual_edm: EDM generates an entire standardized innovation sequence conditioned on target-free route context, then integrates the frozen AR equation.
registered_arms.context_reversed_null: Same initial noise and held-out sequences with only valid context order reversed; response is diagnostic, not a promotion substitute.
registered_arms.measured_reference: Held-out real descriptors accessed only after all candidate samples exist.

model.architecture: Masked non-causal dilated Conv1D residual denoiser with pointwise context and continuous log-sigma embedding.
model.candidate_state: EMA only, frozen before held-out output; raw state saved for reproduction but ineligible for selection

training.precision: bfloat16 model forward where supported; loss and optimizer float32
training.determinism: Seed NumPy, CPU Torch, and CUDA before model construction; disable cuDNN benchmarking and TF32; save raw, EMA, optimizer, and RNG states.
training.checkpoint_selection: Final EMA only; no held-out metric selects a step or state.
training.gpu_policy: Idle guarded CT221 GPU lane only, immediate preemption on terrain demand, one GPU process, no Aero access.

stage_b.selection_rule: Among sources with at least 400 sequences, select the median and maximum sequence-count sources using count then lexical ordering.
stage_b.purpose: Catastrophic-failure screen only; pass authorizes a separately frozen full 12-fold run and does not establish product quality.

evaluation.pass_consequence: Freeze a new full 12-fold preregistration without changing architecture, training length, sampler, clip, candidate state, or metrics.
evaluation.fail_consequence: Close CW11.2 negative, retain coherent AR, and redirect local-morphology neural work to anatomy or Neural Karstogenesis.

forbidden_after_freeze: threshold, clip, sampler, or metric changes
Minecraft compilation before Stage B distribution pass
claim_limit: Two dataset-selected development caves test whether residual EDM avoids catastrophic distribution failure. They do not establish population realism, full source generalization, owner preference, compiled safety, or product readiness.
